## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `shopify-admin-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Sign up for a Shopify developer account

1. <!-- manual: Create a Shopify account via the [Shopify signup portal](https://accounts.shopify.com/signup). -->
2. <!-- manual: Join the [Shopify Partner Program](https://www.shopify.com/partners) to access development tools. -->

## Step 3: Create a new organization

1. <!-- manual: In the Shopify Partner Dashboard, connect to an existing organization or create a new one. -->
2. <!-- manual: Select your main focus as a Shopify partner and follow the on-screen instructions. -->
3. <!-- manual: Provide business contact details and finalize the setup. -->

## Step 4: Create a development store

1. In the Shopify Partner Dashboard, select **Stores** in the left navigation.
2. Select **Create store** to proceed.
3. <!-- manual: Complete the store setup by following the on-screen instructions. -->

## Step 5: Create a new app

1. In your store admin, select **Settings**.
2. Go to the **Apps** section and select **Develop apps**.
3. Select **Allow custom app development**.
4. Select **Create an app**, enter an app name, and confirm.
5. <!-- manual: Select Create an app, enter an app name, and confirm. -->

## Step 6: Generate an access token

1. Once the app is created, select **Configure Admin API scopes** and apply the scopes required for your use case (for example, `read_products`, `write_orders`).
2. Select **Install app** to generate an Admin API access token.
3. Select **Reveal token once** to copy and save the token securely.
